questions.question:
각 문장의 빈칸에 문맥상 들어갈 수 있는 단어의 올바른 영영풀이를 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은? [5점]
• The teacher gave good ________ to me.
• The snowman will ________ in the hot sun.
• My parents always ________ my best friend when she visits my house.
• She needs to ________ for the exam tomorrow.
< 보 기 >
ⓐ to use time doing something
ⓑ an opinion about what someone should do
ⓒ to turn from a solid state into a soft or liquid state
ⓓ not the same as someone or something else
ⓔ to tell somebody that you are pleased that they are there
ⓕ to express or represent something such as an idea, thought, or fact
ⓖ to make or get something or someone ready for something that will happen in the future
